Escalate unresolved or complex issues to the appropriate regional or global IT team, providing clear problem documentation and troubleshooting details. Maintain and organize IT equipment inventory, storage areas, and site technology assets. Follow established IT standards, security policies, and documentation when performing support activities, and protect confidential company and employee information. Contribute to the improvement of IT support operations by identifying documentation gaps and suggesting updates to knowledge base articles.
